name: tencent/hy-mt3-30b-a3b-gguf
title: Tencent ships GGUF builds of Hy-MT3-30B-A3B, its 102-language translation MoE, for llama.cpp
summary: Official GGUF quantizations (down to IQ2) let the 3B-active translation model run locally in llama.cpp, so private on-device translation across 102 languages is now a download away.
